row.notes: cxx=GameWeatherSystem::updateRandomSeed. ws+0x1f18 = weekend (log offset weekend*10); base seed ws+0x1f10 = seed unless the forced override ws+0x1f14 is non-zero (then base = forced); pushes base+weekend*10 to TOD *(ws+0x1d98) via 0x144619cf0 when TOD is set; writes base to *(0x145f8d6c0)+0x174 and weekend to +0x178 (V0245). Only caller WeatherAndTimeOfDayComponent::setWeatherSystemRandomSeed 0x140bde3e0 (component+0x2c4 rnd_seed, weekend = season current_weekend if valid else 0), which afterwards sets ws+0x1f02/+0x1f04/+0x1f08 itself (a direct call skips those). career-editor no longer calls it directly; it goes through Sess_WeatherComponent_SetSystemRandomSeed.
